## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Browser tests for the touched area pass (`npm start` + e.g. `npm run test:e2e`, `test:i18n`, `test:play`, `test:twisty`)
- [ ] User-visible text is added in all 12 languages (`js/i18n/*.js`, `seo/lang/*.json`)
- [ ] No analytics IDs, tokens or `.env` content in the diff
- [ ] New third-party code is MIT/BSD/Apache/MPL-compatible (no GPL) and listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] No personal photos, `ref/` material or sound files without a redistributable license
